problem: A page-driven operations scope model is incomplete when it stores one untyped selected node instead of the independent region, project, store and head-company selections required by the user's work context; that loss also makes page context invisible and leaves project-context CRUD with duplicate project filters. Separately, remote-candidate Select controls were written with Ant Design search configuration nested under the boolean showSearch prop, disconnecting remote candidate queries.
rootCauseLayer: workspace session projection, catalog scope vocabulary, selector state composition and page query context were designed around a single final organization node; scoped content lifecycle was separately treated as page-local query skips instead of one shell-level readiness boundary, and a Redux mirror was incorrectly treated as a synchronous current-entry readiness source across role/context replacement. Remote candidate controls also confused a boolean component prop with top-level query configuration.
finiteApplicabilityDenominator: operations session entry/select contract and generated consumer
every catalog page with a non-NONE requiredDataNodeType
13 operations remote-candidate Select controls in workspace invitation/create and user filters, contract create/list filters, store create/edit forms, and head-company brand authorization
counterexampleBoundary: Associated-entity readbacks remain relationship-scoped rather than data-range-scoped; role capability remains write-only; HEAD_COMPANY remains outside the organization tree; platform-admin is unchanged.
minimalRepair: Use a shared Redux scope-context model mirrored from owner-confirmed candidate selection, a page-required type, owner-rechecked active selection per protected page, reusable selector/context components, and one app-shell guarded mount for incomplete scoped pages that receives the current owner-issued session-entry scope directly rather than an asynchronously mirrored value. For remote candidates, use only the top-level Ant Design showSearch boolean, filterOption=false, and onSearch protocol while preserving each owner query and pagination path.
preventionDestination: focused owner/contract/UI tests plus operations L2 coverage for role locks, selection retention, descendant clearing, HEAD_COMPANY, project-context CRUD and the shell guarded-mount denominator; include a rendered catalog-denominator test proving incomplete entries omit children and NONE remains mountable. Add a source-denominator focused test that rejects nested showSearch configuration and requires the correct remote-candidate Select protocol for all 13 controls.
